Logging macros, identifiers, wallclock helpers, and runtime controls for log output.

# Purpose
`fd_log.h` defines the public interface for the `fd_log` logging system. It provides macros for logging at standard severity levels such as `FD_LOG_DEBUG`, `FD_LOG_INFO`, `FD_LOG_NOTICE`, `FD_LOG_WARNING`, `FD_LOG_ERR`, `FD_LOG_CRIT`, `FD_LOG_ALERT`, and `FD_LOG_EMERG`, plus matching hexdump macros for memory region logging. The file also defines test and runtime check macros such as `FD_TEST`, `FD_TEST_CUSTOM`, `FD_CRIT`, and `FD_ALERT`, which use the logging system to report failed conditions and, for higher severities, stop program execution. It also includes helper macros for formatted hex output and a `FD_LOG_STDOUT` macro for unlocked command output.

The header also declares the main logging APIs and related metadata functions. These include functions for application, thread, host, CPU, group, and user identifiers and names, build information access, wallclock and sleep helpers, log flushing, and runtime configuration of log levels and color output. Several `fd_log_private_*` functions are exposed for internal use and boot-time setup, including initialization, shutdown, custom configuration, and low-level message formatting. This file is a C header intended to be included by code that uses the logging system.
